extracted_page_count.description: Pages the parser actually read, capped at 40.

extraction_notes.description: Free-text caveats from the extractor (raster pages, LLM notes).

issuing_body.description: The issuing body / code-set grouping the entry sits under; explicit null only when the drawing set places the entry nowhere.

source_document_path.description: The resolved path of the drawing-set PDF. Provenance key for the fact.

specification_code.description: The clause/document code **exactly as written on the drawing**, including parenthetical alternative codes and revision suffixes (the parser's own examples: `C242`, `TS 02168.1 (R64)`, `AS3798-2007`); explicit null when the entry has no code of its own.

specification_description.description: The specification's title as the issuing body wrote it.

specifications.description: The extracted governing-specification entries. Empty array is meaningful and must be written.

specifications_table_present.description: Whether the drawing set carried a literal boxed "PROJECT SPECIFICATIONS" table rather than inline/clause-list references.
